items.title: Walter Nelson Interview, 1960-10-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...this is Bill Russell doing the interviewing along with Ralph Collins well you want to give your full name Walter

ctx.x: I'll start off by saying that this interview is being held up at the Piku's bar room in the big dance hall part of it and the corner is Robertson and Ursula and today is March I mean is what's the matter is October I was thinking about some tapes I was marking March a minute ago October the 6th isn't it yeah and if you want to give your full name I'll say first this is Bill Russell doing the interviewing along with Ralph Collins well you want to give your full name Walter oh yeah Walter Nelson Nelson Nelson any…
in St Bernard Parish down below yeah basically called Verrettville what is it Verrettville
